purpose: The formal audit over the 23 accepted events after the project owner's accounting amendment and cohort attestations of 2026-09-26: refetched prices, the archived SEC observations behind every frozen candidate's source hash, and the repository's own protocol, ledger and review files.

provenance.result_channel: check-run annotation 'NRE cohort audit' via the public annotations API

changes_since_the_first_audit_record.candidate_accounting: Passes after the owner's amendment (quarantined with a reason is accounted for); invalid_candidate_dispositions went from 205 to 0.
changes_since_the_first_audit_record.discovery_coverage_review, identity_hist: Pass now that the owner's attestations are recorded in the review file.
changes_since_the_first_audit_record.unchanged: Frozen membership, the protocol hash, the ledger hash, the thresholds and the eligibility rule are unchanged; only the review hash moved.

what_this_establishes: The audit engine itself counts 22 eligible complete events across 22 issuers (23 accepted events; CXT is not eligible) against a target of 20 events across 15 issuers.
Seven premarket and fifteen after-hours eligible events each have a named-reviewer spot check, satisfying the two-per-class requirement.
Every one of the 243 frozen candidates is accounted for: 23 included, 15 excluded with reasons, 205 quarantined with reasons.
what_remains: The project owner's declaration that Milestone 1 is accepted, made outside the code. The engine reports milestone_accepted false by design.
The engine's own stated limit stands: "Hashes and declarations establish internal consistency, not genuine publication, permission or review. Independent evidence sign-off is still required."
The SEC archive artifact expires on 2026-10-20; re-running this audit afterwards needs the owner's NRE-M1-SEC-Freeze-Audit.zip supplied another way. This record preserves the result.
not_a_claim: Not a statement that Milestone 1 is accepted.
Not evidence of any predictive edge; the target is an engineering coverage goal.
No raw prices appear here; the audit result holds only gates, counts and hashes.
